findings.description: The new flag does not disable retries when a retry controller is called directly. It is checked only in decorator wrappers.
findings.rationale: For example, `Retrying(enabled=False, stop=stop_after_attempt(3))(f)` still invokes a failing `f` three times because the unchanged `__call__` retry loop never checks `enabled`. Users of the direct controller API therefore still get retries and a RetryError despite explicitly disabling retrying; AsyncRetrying has the same gap.
